deadline.value: The priority deadline is December 1 and the final deadline February 1, but the page gives no year.
deadline.quote: December 1st: Priority deadline for admission into the Department of Chemistry & Biochemistry

gre_subject.value: The department no longer requires the GRE for domestic or international students.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE is no longer required for both domestic or international students

gre_general.value: The department no longer requires the GRE for domestic or international students.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is no longer required for both domestic or international students

toefl_min.value: The department asks for 80 on the IB-TOEFL, an old-scale figure; the Graduate School's current rule is 4.0 on the new scale, so confirm which scale applies.
toefl_min.quote: 80 on the IB-TOEFL, or 7.0 on the IELTS

also.quote: Internet based TOEFL (IBTOEFL): 80 (if taken before January 21, 2026) or 4.0 (if taken on or after January 21, 2026)

ielts_min.value: The department asks for an IELTS overall band of 7.0, above the University's 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: 80 on the IB-TOEFL, or 7.0 on the IELTS

supervisor.value: The page asks applicants to name faculty of interest but does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Applicants who complete applications by the priority date are considered for Graduate School fellowships and department TA, RA and tuition-waiver awards.
funding.quote: Students with complete applications by this date will be considered for the University’s Graduate School Fellowships

entry_route.value: The University minimum accepts a bachelor's or a graduate degree; the department page adds no rule.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited U.S. institution, or a comparable degree from an international institution | A graduate degree from a regionally accredited U.S. institution, or a comparable degree from an international institution

notes: Final deadline February 1 (no year on the page). Application asks for three faculty of interest.
